prcRules.rule: Annual individual foreign-exchange purchase and sale quota
prcRules.value: USD 50,000 per individual per year (raised from USD 20,000)
prcRules.appliesTo: Individual FX sales, and FX purchases by domestic individuals
prcRules.quote: The Detailed Rules specify that the annual quota for individual foreign exchange purchases be drastically raised from USD 20,000 to USD 50,000
prcRules.note: Above the quota the purchase is not prohibited; S02 says examination of the authenticity of transactions exceeding the quota is strengthened.

prcRules.rule: Lump-sum transfer of an emigrant's PRC property
prcRules.value: Permitted in one lump sum or in batches within the SAFE-approved limit
prcRules.appliesTo: A person who has emigrated; approved by the SAFE branch at the original registered permanent residence
prcRules.quote: The requirement that an immigrant's property can be transferred several times is cancelled ... the bank may remit the relevant funds in a lump sum or in several batches within the limit specified in the approval document.
prcRules.note: S01 also cancelled the requirement to file with SAFE where the total exceeded RMB 500,000.

prcRules.rule: Lump-sum transfer of inherited PRC property
prcRules.value: Permitted; separate applications per decedent no longer required
prcRules.appliesTo: An heir; approved by the SAFE branch at the decedent's original registered permanent residence
prcRules.quote: The requirement that property inherited from different decedents shall be applied and remitted separately [is cancelled]

prcRules.value: A single covered outbound payment above USD 50,000 equivalent requires a tax recordal, subject to exemptions
prcRules.appliesTo: Domestic institutions and individuals paying the listed categories abroad
prcRules.quote: 境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上（不含等值5万美元，下同）下列外汇资金 ... 均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案
prcRules.note: Article 3(13) exempts a domestic individual's private-use FX for study, travel or visiting relatives abroad.

prcRules.value: One recordal per contract, fileable online
prcRules.appliesTo: Multiple payments under the same contract
prcRules.quote: 同一笔合同需要多次对外支付的 ... 仅需在首次付汇前办理备案 ... 备案人可自主选择线上办理，无需再到办税服务厅办理
prcRules.note: S11 confirms the USD 50,000 threshold itself was not changed.

prcRules.rule: Tax authority review window on the recordal
prcRules.value: 15 working days from receipt of the recordal form
prcRules.quote: 主管税务机关应自收到《备案表》后15个工作日内，对备案人提交的《备案表》及所附资料进行审查
prcRules.note: The review expressly checks whether the outbound item has paid tax as required.

prcRules.rule: PRC penalty for splitting a transfer across other people's quotas
prcRules.quote: To prevent acts of avoiding administration, such as repeated purchases of foreign exchange and foreign exchange sales in installments ... the SAFE has established a management information system connecting banks with the SAFE
prcRules.note: The monitoring system is verified; the penalty amount is NOT - see flag F11. Left BLANK.

usRules.value: U.S. dollar; all reported amounts must be expressed in USD
usRules.appliesTo: Every U.S. taxpayer except certain qualified business units
usRules.quote: You must express the amounts you report on your U.S. tax return in U.S. dollars. ... The U.S. dollar is the functional currency for all taxpayers except some qualified business units (QBUs).
usRules.note: Payments of U.S. tax must be remitted to the IRS in U.S. dollars.

usRules.value: None - the IRS has no official exchange rate
usRules.quote: The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate. Generally, it accepts any posted exchange rate that is used consistently.
usRules.note: The IRS yearly average for the Chinese yuan is 7.129 for 2025 and 7.189 for 2024.

usRules.rule: Tax on a personal foreign-currency gain (26 U.S.C. 988(e))
usRules.value: No gain recognised unless the gain exceeds USD 200
usRules.appliesTo: An individual disposing of nonfunctional currency in a personal transaction
usRules.quote: no gain shall be recognized for purposes of this subtitle by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired by such individual and before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.
usRules.note: Section 988(e)(1) also disapplies the rest of section 988 to personal transactions. A transaction is not personal to the extent its expenses meet section 162 or 212.

usRules.quote: Foreign Financial Agency Transaction - Non-Willful Violation of Transaction | 10,000 | 16,536
Foreign Financial Agency Transaction - Willful Violation of Transaction | 100,000 | 165,353
usRules.note: The statute also permits 50% of the account balance where that is greater.

usRules.appliesTo: Taxpayers meeting the tax home test plus the bona fide residence or physical presence test, on Form 2555
usRules.quote: Exclusion amount. For 2026, the maximum exclusion amount has increased to $132,900.
usRules.note: Reaches EARNED income only. It does not exclude a gain on a property sale or an inheritance.

usRules.quote: For taxable years beginning in 2027, the foreign earned income exclusion amount under Sec. 911(b)(2)(D)(i) is $137,300.

usRules.rule: U.S.-China treaty cap on PRC tax on dividends
usRules.value: 10% of the gross amount, where the recipient is the beneficial owner
usRules.appliesTo: Dividends paid by a PRC-resident company to a U.S. resident
usRules.quote: if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends
usRules.note: Article 9(2) of the 1984 Convention. The treaty caps PRC withholding; it does not by itself remove U.S. tax on a U.S. citizen.

usRules.rule: U.S.-China treaty cap on PRC tax on interest
usRules.value: 10% of the gross amount, where the recipient is the beneficial owner
usRules.appliesTo: Interest arising in one state and paid to a resident of the other
usRules.quote: if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest
